about: The Falcon Heavy the assistant built for the owner on the web app, 2026-10-11, which nearly froze their computer: read off their tab with look_at_model, 48 x 32 studs and 332 plates tall. 4,242 of its 4,252 parts: the ten of the astronaut standing by it are left out, because the listing rounds a figure's parts off their studs and the check then refuses the whole design. Rows are submit_design bricks: part, color, x, y, z (studs, plates, studs), face, rot. Driven by tools/web/freeze_check.mjs and src/dev/freeze_probe.gd.
name: Falcon Heavy
